card.name: Inside all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: Short words or word starts inside ALL-CAPS headings, mostly boxed warning titles, such as AND before BEHAVIORS, or the M of MALIGNANCY. Also fires partway through capitalized drug names like DEXTROAMPHETAMINE.

modes.label: Linking word in warning title
modes.description: AND or a word start inside a capitalized boxed warning heading, such as SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS<< AND>> BEHAVIORS; NEURO

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: A word start or middle piece inside an all-caps medical term or name.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS INFECTIONS and<< M>>ALIGNANCY See full prescribing information for

modes.label: Inside capitalized drug name
modes.description: The middle of an all-caps drug name like dextroamphetamine.
modes.example: WARNING: ABUSE, MISUSE, AND ADDICTION DEXTRO<<AM>>PHETAMINE SACCHARATE,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuations starting with RE and away from those starting with CH.
card.plain: It fires inside capital-letter warning headings and drug names, where the next piece is hard to guess.
